literal: From the side having separated, due to a reason him who came, the king, having examined, having stayed, having considered, should accept.
translation: When an associate who previously left returns for a reason, the king should carefully examine the matter, consider it well, and then accept him back.
modern: தன்னிடம் இருந்து பிரிந்து சென்று, பின் ஒரு காரணத்தால் மீண்டும் தன்னிடம் வந்தவனை, அரசன் அதற்கான காரணத்தை ஆராய்ந்து தீர்த்து, நன்கு சிந்தித்து ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises a leader on how to handle an associate who previously left but has now returned. The word 'உழை' refers to the leader's side or proximity. When such a person returns 'காரணத்தின்' (for a specific reason), the king must not accept them blindly. Instead, he should 'இழைத்து இருந்து எண்ணி'—carefully examine the cause of the separation, resolve any underlying issues, and thoughtfully take them back into his circle.
